neighbours.label: sitting/back body-posture words (sit, sat, sitting, backs)
fire: After the long hike, my grandfather sat on a rock to rest.
The children were asked to sit quietly on the carpet.
She was sitting by the window when the letter arrived.
The guests sat down at the long table for dinner.
Please sit up straight while the doctor checks your spine.
Two old men were sitting on the bench feeding pigeons.
The singers stood with their backs to the orchestra.
He sat at his desk and wrote the report in an hour.
quiet: After the long hike, my grandfather drank from the stream to rest.
The children were asked to listen quietly on the carpet.
She was reading by the window when the letter arrived.
The guests arrived at the long table for dinner.
Please breathe deeply while the doctor checks your lungs.
Two old men were talking on the bench feeding pigeons.
The singers sang with their voices to the orchestra.
He worked at his desk and wrote the report in an hour.

notes: ' sit' x4, ' sitting' x4, ' sat' x3, ' back(s)' x5 among top 32; output promotes 'lean'
